data.animaCaption: Pressed flat against the high-rise glass wall in a matte charcoal sleeveless tactical bodysuit with one harness strap unbuckled, she taps her earpiece while easing the front zipper for air. Cold blue server LEDs and the neon city grid far below sculpt crisp highlights along her damp shoulder.
data.promptProse: Framed past blinking blue server racks in the shadowed foreground of a skyscraper data center, Shiki Natsume presses her back flush against a soaring floor-to-ceiling glass curtain wall overlooking a sprawling neon skyline. She wears a sleek matte-charcoal sleeveless tactical bodysuit with the chest zipper drawn down a few inches and one nylon harness buckle unfastened; one gloved hand touches her comms earpiece while the other cools her collar, droplets glistening on her bare arms beneath cool cyan server indicators and distant city lights.
data.story: 三十层高空的玻璃幕墙外是铺满夜色的霓虹城景，机房里只有服务器低沉的散热风声。夏目背贴玻璃松开一侧战术扣，指尖轻点耳麦同时拉低胸口拉链透了口气，冷眼瞥向你——「防火墙还有四十秒重置，别分神，把接口拔出来。」
